sender.bs: „Vaša banka“, njena služba sigurnosti ili odjel za kartice
sender.en: “Your bank”, its security service or card department

name.bs: Lažni bankar: „primijetili smo sumnjivu transakciju, prebacite novac“
name.en: Fake bank employee: “we spotted a suspicious transaction, move your money”

how.bs: Zove mirna, ljubazna osoba koja tvrdi da je iz vaše banke. Na ekranu se može pojaviti i pravi broj banke, jer se broj pozivaoca lako lažira. Kaže da je na vašem računu primijećena sumnjiva transakcija i da novac odmah treba prebaciti na „siguran račun“ ili da joj diktirate kod iz SMS-a ili aplikacije. Žurba je namjerna: da ne stignete nazvati banku sami.
how.en: A calm, friendly person calls claiming to be from your bank. The bank’s real number may even show on screen, because caller ID is easy to fake. They say a suspicious transaction was spotted on your account and that the money must be moved to a “safe account” right away, or that you must read out a code from a text or the app. The rush is deliberate: so you don’t have time to call the bank yourself.

text.bs: Poziv „iz banke“: na računu je sumnjiva transakcija.
text.en: A call “from the bank”: there is a suspicious transaction on your account.

text.bs: Hitno je, ne prekidajte vezu dok se ne „riješi“.
text.en: It’s urgent; don’t hang up until it’s “sorted”.

text.bs: Traže PIN, lozinku ili kod koji vam je stigao SMS-om.
text.en: They ask for your PIN, password or the code you got by text.

text.bs: Ili da novac prebacite na „siguran račun“.
text.en: Or that you move the money to a “safe account”.

text.bs: Dobar dan, zovem iz sigurnosne službe vaše banke. Upravo pokušavaju sa vaše kartice platiti 2.400 KM u inostranstvu. Da zaštitimo sredstva, prebacićemo ih na privremeni zaštićeni račun. Molim vas, nemojte spuštati slušalicu i pročitajte mi kod koji vam sad stiže porukom.
text.en: Good afternoon, I’m calling from your bank’s security service. Someone is trying to pay 2,400 KM abroad with your card right now. To protect the funds we’ll move them to a temporary protected account. Please don’t hang up and read me the code that is arriving by text now.

bs: pozvali sa broja banke traže pin
pokušaj plaćanja karticom u inostranstvu zvali iz banke
službenik banke kaže da ne prekidam vezu
pročitajte mi kod koji vam stiže porukom
en: bank called about a suspicious transaction
bank employee asked for the code from a text
move your money to a safe account
fake bank employee on the phone
call from the bank number asking for my pin
bank security asked for my password
bank called about a card payment attempt abroad
bank employee told me not to hang up
read me the code you are getting by text

bs: Banka telefonom nikad ne traži PIN, lozinku ni kod iz SMS-a, niti da prebacujete novac.
Broj na ekranu ne dokazuje ništa: može biti lažiran.
Pritisak da ne prekidate vezu služi tome da ne provjerite.
en: Your bank never asks by phone for your PIN, password or a code from a text, or for you to move money.
The number on screen proves nothing: it can be faked.
The pressure to stay on the line is there to stop you checking.

bs: Nazovite banku sami, na broj sa kartice ili sa službene stranice, ne preko dugmeta za povratni poziv.
Ako ste već dali podatke, odmah tražite blokadu kartice i pristupa, pa prijavite policiji (122).
en: Call the bank yourself on the number on your card or its official website, not with the call-back button.
If you already gave details, ask straight away for your card and access to be blocked, then report it to the police (122).
